name: Open / deep ocean
notes: Open and deep ocean: no rooted plants at all; near-empty is correct. The only macroscopic 'vegetation' is drifting pelagic Sargassum rafts in the subtropical gyres (Sargasso Sea) and drift kelp; everything else is phytoplankton, not renderable.

ground.name: Pelagic sargassum
ground.source: underwater — Sargassum natans, free-floating holopelagic brown alga of the Sargasso Sea and tropical Atlantic gyre, surface rafts 0.2-1 m thick — Wikipedia

ground.name: Drift sargassum
ground.source: underwater — Sargassum fluitans, second holopelagic species forming Atlantic and Caribbean windrows, 0.2-1 m — Wikipedia
